# CV PDF Pagination QA Checklist

Date: 2026-03-16
Scope: Validate CV PDF quality for long-content scenarios across curated templates.

## Artifacts generated by smoke run
- Folder: uploads/temp/pdf-smoke
- Files expected:
  - smoke-minimal.pdf
  - smoke-sidebar.pdf
  - smoke-corporate.pdf
  - smoke-developer.pdf
  - smoke-creative.pdf
  - smoke-classic.pdf
  - smoke-executive.pdf
  - smoke-timeline.pdf
  - smoke-compact.pdf

## How to run
1. Command:
   - backend: npm run pdf:smoke
2. Result:
   - PDFs regenerated in uploads/temp/pdf-smoke.

## Pass criteria per template
1. No section title appears isolated at page bottom.
2. No experience/education item is split awkwardly mid-block.
3. Contact header remains intact on first page.
4. List bullets and spacing remain consistent after page breaks.
5. Background colors and progress bars preserve print color fidelity.
6. Links are readable and not clipped at right edge.
7. Last page has clean bottom margin (no truncated text).

## Manual review protocol
1. Open each generated PDF.
2. Inspect page transitions around:
   - End of header
   - Start/end of Experiencia
   - Start/end of Educación
   - Skills progress bars
3. Mark status:
   - PASS: no visual or pagination defects
   - MINOR: cosmetic defect but readable
   - FAIL: unreadable split or clipped content

## Visual and automated verification (2026-10-16)

Corrections made after the previous visual review:
- Scope the white sidebar text color to the sidebar so experience descriptions remain readable in the main column.
- Keep sidebar profile content grouped and compact so it ends on page one without a stray link on the next page.
- Allow document and section wrappers to fragment across pages while keeping individual `.entry` and `.panel` blocks together.
- Add the missing entry class to Minimal template experience items.
- Close the shared Puppeteer browser after PDF smoke generation so the command exits successfully.
